programme.title: The Lakes with Paul Rose
programme.desc: Coniston Water isn't the biggest of Cumbria's lakes - but it's one of the most iconic and the place where Donald Campbell died trying to break the world water speed record. Paul meets Campbell's daughter Gina and crew member Robbie Robinson, who was there on the fateful day in January 1967 when Bluebird somersaulted and crashed on the water. The explorer also enters a Lakeland bike ride with a difference before ending his visit with a spot of rock climbing at Dow Crag before the ascent of one of the area's best-known hills, The Old Man of Coniston

programme.title: Sound Waves: The Symphony of Physics

programme.title: Canals: The Making of a Nation
programme.desc: Liz McIvor explores the heritage of the canal network. After years of decline, the inland waterways were eventually restored to become places of leisure and tranquillity. Liz visits the Pontcysyllte Aqueduct in north Wales and travels to Birmingham where canals have become catalysts for property development and urban regeneration

programme.title: The Lakes with Paul Rose
programme.desc: Remote Eskdale is the next destination in the explorer's trek through the Lake District, enjoying the landscapes and meeting its people. The corner of the western Lakes he focuses on is off the normal tourist track, yet boasts England's highest mountain. However, before making the tough climb to the summit of Scafell Pike, Paul meets the folk who run one of the country's most scenic railways, has a close encounter with a vulture, and gets to grips with the locals in a spot of Cumberland wrestling

programme.title: The Cambridgeshire Crucifixion
programme.desc: Dr Corinne Duhig investigates evidence of Roman crucifixion, unearthed in a routine archaeological dig in the Cambridgeshire Fens, performing a CT scan, DNA and isotope analysis of the remains, using them to create a cutting-edge virtual autopsy of the skeleton. Plus, Joe Mullins conducts a world first, a full forensic facial reconstruction of a victim of Roman crucifixion

programme.title: The Human Body: Secrets of Your Life Revealed
programme.desc: Chris and Xand van Tulleken explore the secrets of the body, beginning with the changes it goes through. They examine why human childhood is longer than any other creature on earth, reveal the communities of microbes - the microbiome - that people cultivate throughout their lives, and uncover the mysterious trigger from child to adult

programme.desc: Aminatta Forna presents a documentary examining the literary tradition of Timbuktu in Mali, where hundreds of thousands of manuscripts have come to light in recent years. From the 13th to the 16th centuries, the city was a renowned seat of learning, and its black African scholars were revered throughout the Islamic world

programme.title: Canals: The Making of a Nation
programme.desc: Liz McIvor discovers how carving up the landscape in order to build canals helped further man's understanding of the earth below. William Smith, a surveyor on the Somerset Coal Canal, discovered a way of ordering layers of rocks and eventually created the first geological map of England and Wales. His ideas about the age and formation of the earth were developed long before Darwin published his theories of evolution

programme.title: A Timewatch Guide

With contributions from Charlotte Higgins, Adrian Goldsworthy, Neil Faulkner and Jo Quinn

programme.title: Martin Compston: Living Las Vegas
programme.desc: The actor offers an insider's tour of Las Vegas, revealing the secrets, thrills and irresistible allure that makes his adopted home the ultimate playground. He begins with a visit to a $25,000 hotel suite with its own basketball court and then joins the water maintenance crew at the famous Bellagio fountains. He watches as a British couple tie the knot at the Little White Wedding Chapel and then it's off to gamble a small fortune at the Palms Hotel casino

programme.title: Dispatches

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

As ever, it all begins with cake week, for which Nigella sets the contestants a stout cake signature, before they get artistic in the technical and serve up a self-portrait showstopper

programme.title: Apocalypse
programme.desc: War breaks out amid the urban ruins. with Westsider Dean confronting Eastsiders Steven and Kiera. Over at the Westside's HQ, a posse of Eastsiders demand the return of their stolen chickens, but Paralympian Kelly keeps them at bay. The Westside survivors enjoy a bumper meal of fried Spam, but soon regret it when an Eastside delegation shows up carrying baseball bats. With morale low at the Wests, a disaffected Brooke weighs her options, while Keira and Kyra have an explosive confrontation at Eastside HQ with theatre director Bertie.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay revisits three restaurants he helped that were among the biggest challenges he faced, finding out whether they stayed on the road to recovery or turned back into nightmares. First he meets sisters Rita and Lisa to see if they have continued serving fresh instead of frozen food at Boston's La Galleria 33, before heading to the Olde Hitching Post in Hanson, Massachusetts, to discover whether controlling owner Tom has kept his promise and handed over the reins to his daughter Andrea. Finally, Gordon goes back to the Prohibition gastro pub in Everett, Washington, to catch up with owner Rishi and learn if she has ditched belly-dancing in favour of running her business

programme.title: England 'til I Die
programme.desc: An unflinching, observational documentary from the front line of Britain's asylum system, charting one man's journey into the far-right movement in real time. When government plans are leaked to house up to 600 male asylum seekers at a former military camp in Crowborough, East Sussex, a local utilities manager and father becomes a leader in the campaign against it - a decision that changes his life

programme.title: Location, Location, Location
programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer help two couples searching the south east. English-born Tom and his Floridian wife Kaitlyn have only seen a handful of properties, so balancing his desire for a vegetable garden with her American dream of a big open-plan living space proves a difficult balance for Kirstie. Phil helps Pete and Georgie, who moved into a studio flat right before the lockdown in spring 2020 and are desperate for more space. Wanting to start a family, they're after something to grow into, but Pete is conscious of value for money

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Belfast, Gemma and husband Jim serve up a healthy menu that caters for pescatarians as well carnivores. Finally, Matt and Paul lay on some dance routines and attempt to raise the bar with hearty portions of restaurant-style cuisine

programme.title: Frasier

programme.title: Frasier

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Karl and Sonia from North Yorkshire wish to make a permanent move to the Charente-Maritime region of France, which is famous for its breathtaking scenery of rolling hills, vineyards and forests, its cognac and its welcoming microclimate. The pair are after somewhere big enough for their children and grandchildren to visit, and somewhere where they can also host their wedding. Craig Rowe has his work cut out finding everything on their wish list within their budget of £160,000

programme.title: Help! We Bought a Village
programme.desc: In Italy, Keri and Carolyn bring essential infrastructure to their borgo. In France, Dan throws open his château's doors to the public. And can Mike recover after storms batter his village?

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Sarah and Paul hope their cosy pods will turn all of the B&Bers into happy campers at their 3Trees Glamping in Derbyshire. A spider sighting sends some scurrying - but that's not as scary as the additional cleaning fee. Can a trip to a tram museum get the vibes back on track? For a while, until the inevitable tension returns when talk of payment day rears its ugly head over the campfire

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: On the penultimate night in Manchester, cabaret practitioner Vanessa is turning her modest Mancunian semi into a Chicago speakeasy, with home comfort food planned and a side order of illicit hooch. Richard is blown away by Vanessa's outfit and it's not long before he's accusing Danny of dressing like a Butlin's red coat. Amy and Pauline have a snoop around the house and discover a treasure trove of outfits from Vanessa's cabaret shows. The evening really takes off when Vanessa's alter ego Coco Deville takes to the floor accompanied by a small band and some ostrich feathers. The piña colada crumble amazes Danny and Richard, and the group learn the subtle art of face yoga. Will Vanessa's illicit night of burlesque bravado ruffle feathers?

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun: Where Are They Now?
programme.desc: In Spain, Andy and Yuri have been dogged by delays, but are finally launching their B&B. First shown in July 2024

Comedy, starring Jason Biggs, Shannon Elizabeth, Chris Klein, Alyson Hannigan, Mena Suvari, Seann William Scott and Eugene Levy

An economics student offers him a solution to his problems, finding a ground-breaking way to analyse the performance of cheaper players and combining their abilities to form a winning side. Fact-based drama, starring Brad Pitt, Jonah Hill and Philip Seymour Hoffman

He takes piano lessons, makes his way into the Royal Academy of Music, and hones his craft in local pubs before becoming one of the world's biggest pop stars. Golden Globe-winning biopic, starring Taron Egerton, Jamie Bell and Richard Madden

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can (2002)
programme.desc: The story of Frank Abagnale Jr, who found notoriety as a teenager conning and charming his way across America. Posing as a pilot, a doctor and a lawyer, Frank was able to fund an extravagant lifestyle while outwitting the FBI at every turn. Fact-based drama, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Tom Hanks, Christopher Walken, Martin Sheen and James Brolin

programme.title: No Country for Old Men (2007)

Meanwhile, a world-weary sheriff struggles to make sense of the escalating chain of violence. The Coen brothers' Oscar-winning crime thriller, starring Josh Brolin, Javier Bardem, Tommy Lee Jones, Kelly Macdonald and Woody Harrelson

Director Emerald Fennell's Oscar-winning crime thriller, starring Carey Mulligan, Bo Burnham and Alison Brie

Frank Darabont's drama, starring Tim Robbins, Morgan Freeman, Bob Gunton, William Sadler, Clancy Brown and Gil Bellows

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo tells the story of how a small island on the edge of Europe built the biggest empire the world has ever seen. In the first episode, Michael travels to India to uncover how the British East India Company - the world's first multinational corporation - raised a private army to create an empire. Beginning his journey in the slums of Kolkata, he explores the ruins of the grand residence of Clive of India, who became the undisputed ruler of Bengal - amassing a vast personal fortune and making millions for shareholders in Britain

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Jamaica, the Caribbean capital of the Empire, heading to Fort Charles where the Empire enlisted the help of pirates to defend the new territory from the Spanish. At the old naval headquarters, Michael learns how the Royal Navy moved in to replace the pirates as Britain struck a deal with Spain to keep her territories. The island needed a new source of wealth, and found it in the triangular trade as slaves were shipped from Africa to work sugar plantations. In Pinnacle, birthplace of the Rastafari movement, Michael learns how Jamaicans were later inspired to create a new religion

programme.title: Could Hitler Have Been Stopped? The Politics of Appeasement
programme.desc: Historians argue about whether Adolf Hitler could have been stopped before the Second World War ever broke out

programme.title: D-Day: Last Words
programme.desc: Part two of two. The recollections of those involved in D-Day on June 6, 1944, including the memories of a British sailor who laid underwater charges that would blow up German defences, as well French resistance fighters and German defenders

programme.desc: Nick Knowles heads to Maidstone, Kent, to meet former Royal Engineer and paratrooper Mo Morris. programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
